title: NASA Task Load Index (raw)
instructions: Rate the lesson you just completed on each of the six scales. Mark the point on each line that best represents your experience.

scale.note: Each subscale is shown as a 21-tick line (0 to 20) and stored as tick x 5, giving 0 to 100 per docs/14 section 2.4.

subscales.title: Mental Demand
subscales.stem: How mentally demanding was the task?

subscales.title: Physical Demand
subscales.stem: How physically demanding was the task?

subscales.title: Temporal Demand
subscales.stem: How hurried or rushed was the pace of the task?

subscales.title: Performance
subscales.stem: How successful were you in accomplishing what you were asked to do?

subscales.title: Effort
subscales.stem: How hard did you have to work to accomplish your level of performance?

subscales.title: Frustration
subscales.stem: How insecure, discouraged, irritated, stressed, and annoyed were you?

scoring.note: Raw TLX (RTLX): rawTLX = mean of the six subscale values, 0 to 100. No pairwise source-of-load weighting. Performance is scored as stored (0 = perfect, 100 = failure), so higher is worse on every subscale. Subscales are reported individually with Holm correction per docs/14.
